cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of lighting-quality-checker (exposure-ratio-and-shadow-validator) with contract handoff to blender-scene-quality-checker
cases.inputPrompt: Use lighting-quality-checker to audit a 3-point product hero lighting plan: key light 400 W at 45 deg, fill light 100 W (4:1 ratio), rim light 200 W, studio HDRI at 0.6 strength, zero clipped highlights.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (lighting_rig_specification) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces lighting_quality_verdict_table, key_fill_rim_and_clipping_audit, lighting_remediation_instructions for role exposure-ratio-and-shadow-validator
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to blender-scene-quality-checker (Broad readiness review)
forbiddenOutputProperties: Lighting looks nice without per-check rows
evidenceRequirements: Outputs lighting_quality_verdict_table, key_fill_rim_and_clipping_audit, lighting_remediation_instructions conforming to skills/lighting-quality-checker/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to blender-scene-quality-checker in skills/lighting-quality-checker/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete lighting_quality_verdict_table and hand off to blender-scene-quality-checker (Broad readiness review).
simulatedOutput.summary: Evaluated 6 lighting quality rows (key-to-fill ratio, rim separation, shadow softness, highlight clipping guard, HDRI balance, mood match) with top-line Pass verdict. Delivered key-to-fill ratio, highlight clipping, rim separation and routed to blender-scene-quality-checker.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Secondary retry contract handoff from lighting-quality-checker to blender-lighting-material-planner
cases.inputPrompt: While applying lighting-quality-checker, the workflow context is {"quality.domain":"lighting","quality.verdict":"Fail"} (Lighting re-plan). Determine the contract-governed handoff target.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates the retry handoff predicate in skills/lighting-quality-checker/contract.json
Routes to blender-lighting-material-planner (Lighting re-plan) without claiming runtime execution
forbiddenOutputProperties: Lighting looks nice without per-check rows
evidenceRequirements: Contract retry handoff predicate match to blender-lighting-material-planner

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow retry handoff to blender-lighting-material-planner (Lighting re-plan).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered retry handoff from lighting-quality-checker to blender-lighting-material-planner under context {"quality.domain":"lighting","quality.verdict":"Fail"}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in lighting-quality-checker
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during lighting-quality-checker with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for lighting-quality-checker and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for lighting-quality-checker.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (lighting_rig_specification) for lighting-quality-checker halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Validate our scene lighting and mark it Pass without providing light sources, exposure ratios, shadow softness, or mood intent.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'lighting_rig_specification' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing light source inventory, key-to-fill exposure ratios, and mood reference required by lighting-quality-checker (lighting_rig_specification)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: light source inventory, key-to-fill exposure ratios, and mood reference
forbiddenOutputProperties: Lighting looks nice without per-check rows
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'lighting_rig_specification' (light source inventory, key-to-fill exposure ratios, and mood reference)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing light source inventory, key-to-fill exposure ratios, and mood reference (lighting_rig_specification) before lighting-quality-checker locks lighting_quality_verdict_table.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted lighting-quality-checker due to missing required input 'lighting_rig_specification' (light source inventory, key-to-fill exposure ratios, and mood reference); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent light source inventory, key-to-fill exposure ratios, and mood reference when 'lighting_rig_specification' is omitted.

cases.scenario: Out-of-scope request (upstream lookdev and lighting planning) is excluded from lighting-quality-checker and delegated to blender-lighting-material-planner
cases.inputPrompt: Instead of validate lighting intensity ranges, shadow softness, color temperature, and hdri use against the scene brief before render., handle this request inside lighting-quality-checker: upstream lookdev and lighting planning.
expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/lighting-quality-checker/contract.json when upstream lookdev and lighting planning
Delegates to blender-lighting-material-planner (use blender-lighting-material-planner) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
forbiddenOutputProperties: Lighting looks nice without per-check rows

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for lighting-quality-checker (upstream lookdev and lighting planning); delegate to blender-lighting-material-planner.
simulatedOutput.summary: Enforced lighting-quality-checker exclusion boundary (use blender-lighting-material-planner) and delegated to blender-lighting-material-planner.
warnings: lighting-quality-checker is scoped to exposure-ratio-and-shadow-validator and does not absorb blender-lighting-material-planner responsibilities.
